onset.Description: Seconds from the first ECoG sample. reach_onset uses NWB ReachEvents timestamps (ECoG clock) unchanged. coarse_label onsets = source_time_of_day - D, where D is the UTC seconds-of-day of the NWB session_start_time (the ECoG start); negative values are labels starting before the first ECoG sample. nan_segment = runs of samples that are NaN on all channels in the source.

duration.Description: reach: source reach duration (stop - start); coarse_label: label interval; nan_segment: run length.

sample.Description: round(onset * 500), zero-based; n/a for onsets before the first sample.

Levels.reach_onset: Wrist movement initiation event (authors, pose-based, visually validated).
Levels.coarse_label: Coarse behavioural state label from video annotation (authors).
Levels.nan_segment: Samples stored as NaN on all channels in the source (monitoring break).

coarse_label.Description: Source intervals/epochs label, verbatim. Boundaries are at the source 30 Hz frame grid; the source converter assigns each transition to the last frame of the previous label (np.diff index without +1).

bimanual_overlap.Description: Source Bimanual_overlap (the source column description calls it a fraction of the contralateral movement duration; the source CSV header says seconds).

source_time_of_day.Description: Original day-clock time (seconds after midnight) from NWB intervals/reaches or intervals/epochs.
